description: Set the document's pixel aspect ratio (View > Pixel Aspect Ratio), for video work with non-square pixels, and/or toggle View > Pixel Aspect Ratio Correction, which previews the image with those pixels

ratio.description: Pixel width divided by height: 1 is square, e.g. 0.91 for D1/DV NTSC, 1.09 for D1/DV PAL, 2 for anamorphic 2:1

toggleCorrection.description: Toggle Pixel Aspect Ratio Correction (on if it was off, off if it was on)

name: set_pixel_aspect_ratio
title: Set Pixel Aspect Ratio
